academic_basis: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, Journal of Financial Economics 104 (2012), 228-250

rule.signal: sign of trailing 252-session adjusted-close return at each month-end
rule.execution: next session open; long when positive and short when negative; hold until next monthly execution
rule.risk_weighting: inverse 60-session daily volatility, normalized to equal portfolio risk weights with maximum 30 percent per instrument
rule.portfolio_target_volatility: not applied in edge screen; returns normalized to unit gross weight

economics.note: proxy screen only; contract commissions, roll and micro-future granularity are mandatory downstream
